description: Configuration for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) answer system

extraction.description: Extraction-only mode (no LLM, fastest, no API costs)

openai_gpt35.description: OpenAI GPT-3.5-turbo (good quality, requires API key)

openai_gpt4.description: OpenAI GPT-4 (best quality, higher cost, requires API key)

local_flan_t5_base.description: Local Flan-T5 Base (good quality, runs locally, ~1GB download)

local_flan_t5_large.description: Local Flan-T5 Large (better quality, runs locally, ~3GB download)

notes.temperature: Lower values (0.1-0.3) = more focused/deterministic, higher values (0.7-1.0) = more creative
notes.max_tokens: Maximum length of generated answer in tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)
notes.top_k_chunks: Number of retrieved chunks to use as context (default: 3)
